name: Tablet Mode (floating keyboard)
author: Mystical89
description: Tablet mode for detachables: auto-rotation, a floating on-screen keyboard with a Russian layout, touch tweaks when the keyboard comes off, window fitting above the dock, and a switch back to plain Omarchy.

barWidget.description: Tablet mode card: switch modes, show the on-screen keyboard, lock or turn the screen, or disable it all.
